content.title: Rory McIlroy is a 2-time Masters champ. What to know about him
content.text: Updated April 12, 2026, 7:04 p.m. ETRory McIlroy has done it. Tied with Cameron Young for the lead entering the final round of this year's Masters, McIlroy used a birdie burst in the middle of his round to provide enough room to again win the green jacket.This was McIlroy's 18th time at Augusta National, and he finally broke through last year with his first green jacket. With today's victory, he is the fourth golfer in history to win back-to-back green jackets.What is Rory McIlroy's age?McIlroy was born on May 4, 1989 making him 36 years old.Where is Rory McIlroy from?McIlroy was born in Holywood, Northern Ireland, and has homes in Northern Ireland, in Wentworth outside of London, and in Jupiter, FL.How many PGA titles has Rory McIlroy won?McIlroy's has 29 PGA Tour wins. In addition to the Masters, some of the highlights include two PGA Championships, the Open Championship, the U.S. Open, the Ryder Cup, and two Players Championships. He also represented Ireland in the 2020 and 2024 Olympics.How much is Rory McIlroy worth?McIlroy had won the second highest amount of prize money over the course of his career: $110,196,641 with just over $2.2 million year-to-date. Tiger Woods is ahead of him by about $10.8 million over the course of his career. This does not include McIlroy's Masters winnings this year.Last year, Forbes ranked McIlroy as the third highest paid golfer in the world with $84 million in earnings over a 12-month period. This broke down to $39 million on-course and $45 million off-course. The highest paid were Jon Rahm followed by Scottie Scheffler.His net worth is estimated to be north of $200 million, but the exact figure fluctuates depending on the source.Who is Rory McIlroy's wife?McIlroy's wife is Erica Stoll, who was a PGA transport official when they met. April 22 will mark nine years of marriage for the couple.How many children does Rory McIlroy have?McIlroy and Stole share a five-year-old daughter Poppy.Rory tee time SundayMcIlroy and Young will be the last to tee off, doing so at 2:25 p.m.What are Rory McIlroy's odds of winning Masters 2026?As of publication, BetMGM gave McIlroy the best odds at +160 followed by Young at +240.Rory McIlroy withdraws RBC HeritageMcIlroy has confirmed he won't be competing at the upcoming RBC Heritage in South Carolina. According to multiple news outlets, he's often opted to miss it as he recovers from the Masters.Miguel Legoas is a Deep South Connect Team Reporter for USA Today.
